ImageDescription.value: The APF M1000 (some are also labeled the MP1000), a video game console released by APF Electronics in 1978.  A follow up to APF's line of Pong consoles, the MP1000 was a true microprocessor-based system that was powered by a Motorola 6800.  The system wasn't commercially successful, releasing alongside a glut of other consoles, and APF Electronics filed for bankruptcy a few years later.
